verdict.rationale: The runtime probe shows the CLI accepts an agent flag (`-a claude-code`), implying the tool is built to target multiple coding agents, and docs confirm a first-class Claude Code plugin/marketplace integration, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents Codex, Cursor, or other harness-specific install instructions or confirms they work end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit per-harness docs/examples for Codex, Cursor or other agents beyond Claude Code, and hands-on verification of installing into those other harnesses.
